property_summary: For any token id, the balanceOf for an account must return the balance stored under that specific id, but the buggy contract returns the balance stored under id+1, so calling balanceOf for the maximum possible id (type(uint256).max) will read an out-of-bounds storage slot and revert, whereas the reference returns the stored balance (possibly zero) successfully.
change_summary: Change the return expression to return balance for a fixed different id (e.g., id+1) so the caller gets the wrong token balance.
